lede: Euroauto Garage is a car workshop at Premier@Kaki Bukit. Its own website says it was established in 2016 and specialises in the servicing, maintenance and repair of luxury, exotic and high-performance cars.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention experience with performance and exotic cars including a Bentley Flying Spur and a Maserati GT, thorough checks, regular progress updates and professional, transparent service.
faqs: Google Maps lists it as a car repair workshop.
The hours are listed in the Google Maps section above. Please see Google Maps for current hours.
services_note: Services as listed on the workshop's own website, euroauto.com.sg.
